profile.headline: Master - Software Engineer at SRA International

positions.title: Senior PeopleSoft Developer
positions.description:
Subcontractor to Lockheed Martin for US Navy
Senior PeopleSoft Developer for the US Navy Performance Appraisal and Reporting System (NPARS) contract 
Senior PeopleSoft programmer supporting US Navy Health Professionals Incentive Program contract •	Maintained system for providing incentive pay and tuition information to Navy personnel going into medical professions 
•	Built performance management application based on specifications provided by US Navy users and government contractors
•	Used PeopleCode to interface with Adobe Forms application and to create U/I 
•	Built BI (XML) Publisher reports to provide reporting options to users
•	Used JavaScript to manipulate delivered PeopleSoft pages to meet user requirements

PeopleSoft PeopleTools release 8.52.07
PeopleSoft Application release 9.01

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the maintenance of the PeopleSoft Human Capital Management databases running on Oracle RDBMS and IBM AIX UNIX platform, including on-call support 24/7.  
In 2009 Ricoh moved to the Oracle HRMS system and my responsibilities fell into more Functional IT than development, including project management and some production support.
•  Resolved production support issues for core HCM, ESS, MSS, Benefits Administration, North American Payroll and PS Query
•  Created and maintained SQR interfaces and reports 
•  Created and maintained custom applications using PeopleTools including use of workflow
•  Created SQRs to notify direct managers and upper management of delinquent employee activities via email and Worklist items
•  Created UNIX scripts to run the SQRs in batch schedules
•  Maintained an Application Engine program populating employee security information from Lotus Notes, used as the Active Directory, to update PeopleSoft Securityo  Customized PeopleSoft Self Service Forgot Password functionality
•  Created and maintained UNIX scripts used to run programs on weekly, daily, monthly and biweekly schedules
•  Modified eBenefits Pages, PeopleCode and SQR programs for Open Enrollment each year 
•  Trained co-workers on resolving Payroll issues including Pay Calculation and Pay Confirmation aborts
•  Implemented Tax Upgrades 
•  Implemented in PeopleSoft upgrades to versions 7.5, 8.3 and 8.9 - technical lead for 8.9
•  2009 merged of Ricoh and IKON moving from PeopleSoft to Oracle HRMS within 45 days project plan
•  Completed Project Management training 
•  Managed Performance Management project implementation on Oracle HRMS
•  Continued honing Project Management skills on minor change requests for HR on Oracle HRMS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a team that was responsible for the maintenance of the PeopleSoft HR/Payroll system on Oracle RDBMS and UNIX 
•  Resolved production support issues for Human Resources and North American Payroll
•  Created and maintained SQR interfaces and reports
•  Created and maintained custom applications using PeopleTools 
•  Participated as in PeopleSoft upgrade to version 7.5

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Part of a team that was responsible for the maintenance of the PeopleSoft HR/Payroll system on a DB2 platform.
•  Resolved production support issues for Human Resources and Payroll
•  Created and maintained SQR interfaces and reports
•  Created and maintained custom applications using PeopleTools 
•  Participated as in PeopleSoft upgrade from version 3.1 to version 5.x
•  Payroll Analyst on main frame system prior to moving to Atlanta for PeopleSoft Payroll analyst position
•  Accounts Receivable data entry support – Summer Intern for 4 summers
